title: QUIZ - 11
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Round a decimal number to a specified place value
questions.question: Round 279.395 to the nearest hundredth.
questions.explanation: Rounding 279.395 to the nearest hundredth gives 279.39, based on the digit immediately to the right of that place.
questions.hint: Look at the digit just to the right of the rounding place to decide whether to round up or down.

questions.learningObjective: Perform arithmetic operations on decimal numbers with correct place value alignment
questions.question: Calculate: \( 36.33 - 23.38 \)
questions.explanation: Aligning decimal points and computing gives \( 36.33 - 23.38 \) = 12.95.
questions.hint: Line up the decimal points before adding, subtracting, or multiplying.

questions.learningObjective: Compare two decimal numbers to determine which is greater
questions.question: Which decimal is greater: 55.6 or 55.83?
questions.explanation: Comparing digit by digit from the left, 55.83 is greater than 55.6.
questions.hint: Compare digits starting from the leftmost (largest place value) digit.
